div.div:
*AEL – Adabas Encryption for Linux
*NAS – Natural Availability Server replicas share session state via Azure Cache for Redis
*Namespaces: adanat-web (Natural OpenAPI Server, NAS) · adanat (Natural and Adabas components)
*Pods are spread across zones with topology spread constraints / anti-affinity
*Application Gateway (AGIC) endpoints: https://api.adanat.example.com → natural-openapi service ·
https://nas.adanat.example.com → natural-availability service (host names are examples)
